findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in getDocument's query
findings.body: The diff removes `tenantId: ctx.user.tenantId` from the `where` clause of `db.documents.findFirst` in `getDocument` (`src/documents.ts:33`). After this change, any authenticated user of any tenant who learns or guesses another tenant's document ID receives that document — a cross-tenant IDOR / broken tenant isolation. The remaining `ctx.user` check verifies authentication only, not tenant authorization; the `tenantId` field on `ctx.user` and its prior use in this query establish that this lookup was intentionally tenant-scoped before the PR. The repository contains no compensating control (no other source files, middleware, or row-level policy), and the PR's stated intent to "preserve existing contracts" contradicts removing the very predicate that encoded the data-isolation contract. Restore the predicate: `where: { id, tenantId: ctx.user.tenantId }`.
